prompt.task: Analyze the given time-series data, identify any trends, patterns, or anomalies, and provide insights into the nature of the dataset.
prompt.additional_context: The data set consists of time series data recorded once per minute. The origin of the data is not known, so try to provide a neutral interpretation.
prompt.desired_output: Provide a structured and time-based analysis of the time series data. Find trends, fluctuations or anomalies.
